name: TAO
summary: TAO is JUNO’s close-to-reactor companion experiment, built to measure a high-resolution antineutrino reference spectrum at Taishan. Its low-temperature, silicon-photomultiplier readout provides high light collection in a compact detector.
detection_principle: A spherical liquid-scintillator target detects inverse beta decay. Operating at approximately minus 50 degrees Celsius reduces silicon-photomultiplier dark noise; extensive optical coverage supports precision spectral reconstruction.

results.summary: The first result compared 31.3 reactor-on and 29.4 reactor-off days and observed a clear IBD excess, validating high-performance reactor-antineutrino measurement.
